actions.action: Check top 2-3 inches of soil with finger before watering
Water thoroughly when dry and let excess drain
Check pots have drainage holes and no water pooling in the basket or inner pot
Alternatively, raise humidity by grouping plants together
Move plants to the brightest spot, such as a south- or west-facing window
Move plants away from cold drafts and heaters
Trim dead brown tissue with clean scissors

reason: The answer names repotting stress as the main cause but calls the window spot fine, so it misses the cold window as a cause; advice to avoid cold drafts and be patient is present but buried among other tips, and nothing in it is harmful.
